U.S. airstrikes targeted a railway bridge in Aqqala, Golestan Province, northern Iran. The strikes left a large crater beneath the tracks, severing the rails and concrete supports.
The bridge is part of the Incheboroon–Gorgan railway line, which opened in late 2013 and serves as the final link of the New Eurasian Land Bridge, connecting Xi'an in eastern China to the Aprin Dry Port near Tehran.
According to available information, the bridge was struck by seven projectiles.

The strike killed the militants and destroyed their pickup truck.
U.S. airstrikes also targeted the port city of Bushehr in southern Iran. According to Iranian sources, one of the strikes hit an air defense site, which can be seen in the footage.

An Indian Navy Drishti-10 Starliner unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) crashed in an open field near Dharampur village, close to Porbandar Airfield in Gujarat, India.
According to the Indian Navy, the UAV went down shortly after takeoff in the vicinity of the airfield.
The cause of the crash has not been confirmed. The Drishti-10 fleet has previously experienced multiple SATCOM disconnection incidents, which may have been a contributing factor.
The Drishti-10 is the Indian-built version of the Israeli Hermes 900 UAV, manufactured by Adani Defence & Aerospace under license from Elbit Systems.
